prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical 9:16 refined coastal fashion editorial of an original adult blonde woman standing on a pebbled beach in warm late-afternoon light. She wears an elegant opaque white swim dress with a subtle gold clasp, gold hoop earrings, and slim gold bangles. Use a balanced three-quarter pose with one hand near the neck and the other relaxed at her side. Place turquoise sea behind her, rocky coastal cliffs catching the sun, and a small sailboat on the distant horizon. Use an 85mm editorial portrait perspective, natural skin texture, tailored fabric folds, controlled highlights, and a quietly confident non-sexualized mood. No celebrity likeness, text, logo, or watermark.
